addAdapter(address).details: Requirements:      - Adapter must be configured with `vault` equal to this strategy address.        Otherwise adapter calls guarded by `onlyVault` will revert and/or funds        on withdraw will not be returned to this strategy.      - Adapter `underlying()` must equal `ASSET` (USDC native on Arbitrum).      - Adapter must implement isPushMode() to auto-configure deposit mode.

constructor.details: SECURITY: Deployer receives NO roles. All admin roles go directly to ROOT_TIMELOCK.      Bootstrapper receives BOOTSTRAP_ROLE only (not admin) for one-shot adapter registration.      After bootstrapper.bootstrap() is called, BOOTSTRAP_ROLE is renounced permanently.

params._bootstrapper: StrategyBootstrapper address (granted BOOTSTRAP_ROLE for adapter registration)
params.asset_: USDC token address (IERC20Metadata, Arbitrum One native)

deposit(uint256).details: Only callable by Core. "No cash": idle ≤ dustTolerance after.

emergencyRecallAll().details: Only DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE or CORE_ROLE. Idle may exceed dustTolerance after.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

harvest().details: KEEPER_ROLE or CORE_ROLE (CoreVault/StrategyRouter). Existing upkeep         callers may ignore the return values; the selector is unchanged.

returns.pnl: Signed change in strategy NAV during this call, including redeployment.             Previously accrued interest is already in NAV and is not reported again.
returns.realized: Adapter-reported USDC rewards realized into the strategy, before                  redeployment. This is not a transfer to Core.

harvest(address).details: Only Core. Does not redeploy idle; funds are transferred out to receiver.

params.receiver: Target address to receive realized USDC (e.g., Core vault)

returns.realized: Total USDC sent to receiver across adapters

name().details: `pure` (not a stored/inherited constant) so the literal is         compiled into this contract only, not every delegatecall module         that shares StrategyStorageLayout.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

realizeLiquidity(uint256).details: Only KEEPER_ROLE or CORE_ROLE. Funds stay in vault (not sent to third parties).

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `account`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

selectiveRecall(address[]).details: Only DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Per-adapter try/catch: failures don't block others.         Each target must be a registered adapter (else InvalidAdapter).         Emits SelectiveRecallExecuted with total realized USDC.

setRebalancePlanModule(address).details: Architectural completion: planModule has prepareRebalance/         executeRebalanceStep/cancelRebalancePlan that vault routes via fallback.         Must be called BEFORE finalizeParameters. Set-once via require.

params.on: True to enable, false to disable

withdraw(uint256,address).details: Only callable by Core. Leaves at most dust idle.

withdraw(uint256,address,bool).details: Cascade fix P1.5 — supports tests expecting strict-failure semantics.

params.revertOnShortfall: If true, reverts when adapters can't deliver `assets`.                           If false, behaves like the 2-arg overload (returns realized amount).

withdrawAll(address).details: Best effort: recalls disabled/flagged adapters too, retains unrecovered      positions, and never redeploys recovered cash. Caller must hold CORE_ROLE.

adapterCount().notice: Number of registered adapters (needed by external lens)

addAdapter(address).notice: Add a new lending adapter. Only DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

canHarvest().notice: Returns true if harvest is possible (threshold or time).

constructor.notice: Deploys the vault with NO privileged deployer.

degradedModeActive().notice: DegradedMode: true when system in defensive mode (auto-set by _isDegradedMode check).

deposit(uint256).notice: Deposit USDC from Core. Allocates immediately to adapters.

emergencyRecallAll().notice: Emergency recall: withdraw all from all adapters (even flagged/disabled).

harvest().notice: Harvest yield from adapters, auto-deploys idle.

harvest(address).notice: Harvest yield from adapters and send directly to receiver (Core). IStrategyVault-compatible.

hasIdleCash().notice: Returns true if idle USDC > dustTolerance.

isInternallyRebalancing().notice: True if multi-step rebalance plan is actively executing

lastInternalRebalanceTs().notice: Timestamp of last internal rebalance completion

lastRelCapMandateTs(address).notice: Per-adapter timestamp of last rel-cap mandate trigger.

liquidityReadinessBps().notice: Weighted average liquidity across enabled adapters (10000 = fully liquid)

metadataId().notice: Stable identifier for this strategy's off-chain metadata document         (metadata/strategies/earn-usdc.json, `id` field). The full         human-readable description and taxonomy live there, not on-chain.

name().notice: Human-readable strategy name. Required by core's IStrategy.

pause().notice: Pause vault (escape hatch). Only DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.         Only withdrawToCore and emergencyRecallAll remain enabled.

realizeLiquidity(uint256).notice: Realize liquidity pro-rata from enabled adapters.

rebalancePenaltyBps().notice: Penalty signal: higher = "don't move capital now"

rebalancePlanModule_addr().notice: rebalancePlanModule_addr placeholder (1 slot, EIP-170 refactor reserved)

safetyFallbackAdapters(uint256).notice: Ordered list of governance-approved safety venues (priority desc).

selectiveRecall(address[]).notice: Selective recall: withdraw from a subset of adapters by address.

settingsModule_addr().notice: settingsModule_addr — StrategySettingsModule (governance setters, last in fallback chain)

toggleAdapter(address,bool).notice: Enable or disable an adapter. Only DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

totalAssets().notice: Returns total assets (idle + adapters). Never reverts — uses positionAssets fallback.

withdraw(uint256,address).notice: Withdraw USDC to Core (or receiver). Realizes liquidity pro-rata if needed.

withdrawAll(address).notice: Router-compatible emergency exit, available even while paused.

withdrawableAssets().notice: Returns withdrawable assets (idle + adapters' withdrawable). Never reverts.

withdrawalLockSeconds().notice: Advisory withdrawal lock in seconds. effectiveWithdrawalLockSeconds() returns this × 7 in degraded mode.
